difficulty_reason: The construction assigns generators of the Cyc complex from cyclically ordered vertex partitions and ties differential coefficients to distance data from the adjugate Laplacian; showing it is a complex and exact in degree zero does not establish the full resolution. The inductive step identifies selected Schreyer tau-syzygies from weighted reverse-lexicographic Groebner bases with each next differential, using partition correspondences and monomial-quotient generators across homological degrees. This combines directed-graph Laplacians, lattice ideals, Groebner basis theory, and homological algebra in a uniform all-n resolution argument beyond doctoral qualifying material.
